Spider-Man Film Crosses $2 Billion Global Box Office Mark

The film 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has surpassed $2 billion in global box office earnings, becoming the second-fastest film in history to reach this milestone. It trails only 'Avengers: Endgame' in speed to achieve this figure. The movie has also been noted for its strong performance, potentially positioning it among the top 5 highest-grossing films of all time. Separately, other films like 'Awarapan 2' and 'Batwara 1947' are also reporting box office collections in India, with 'Awarapan 2' reportedly earning over Rs 110 crore.
